title: Family: musical cousin, church singers, brothers
summary: His father played no instrument, but his cousin Johnny Richardson, a bass player, taught him and a cousin gave him his first horn; his family sang in church and his brothers dabbled in music.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Did your father play an instrument?
No. He was a butcher. He was in the meat factory there.
So, he didn't play any instruments then?
part of the family, like a first cousin, Johnny Richardson. He was a bass player. H was supposed to have been, he was rated the best bass player around that part of the country.
And so, he used to do a lot with me and teach me. And also, my first cousin, a brother, he told me, he gave me my first horn.

So, the family, my mother was in the choir in church. Practically, my whole family - my aunts, my uncles - they all sang in the choir. So, when I was, got to be about 9, and playing my horn, I used to go and start playing my horn with them in the choir.
So, your mother sang as did other members of your family.
But, did she play an instrument?
She didn't play an instrument. Okay. Did you have any brothers or sisters?
One sister and three brothers. My brother, next to me, he played

trumpet. But, he didn't go out for it like I did. And my other two brothers, they just played around with drums. They'd never get right into it. But, they passed after they came out of the war, second World War. They had, during the war, they kinda got it there.
